snippet.title: Vaporwave Battler Trailer!
snippet.description:
This is a trailer for my new randomized turn based vaporwave 80s style retro game, Vaporwave Battler! Vaporwave Battler is a turn based trip back in time where you'll use every gnarly move you've got to fight through the best the 1980s and 1990s has to throw at you.

-Turn based single player action with random enemies and moves thrown at you for a more roguelike experience -- no two runs are ever the same
-Set in the glowy retro neon future
-Pixel art as you remember it under a CRT haze
-10 unique enemies to encounter
-10 unique moves to unleash
-How many bad guys can you take down?

Follow my Itch so you can be the first to grab it June 9th: https://beanbunny.itch.io/
